snippet.title: Winter Berry Makeup Tutorial with my recent favorite Japanese brand [KATE] ft.
snippet.description:
+ 본 영상은 KATE의 유료광고 영상입니다. + 


PR:KATE
🍓 Strawberry makeup was all the rage this summer, but now that winter's 
creeping in, it's time to switch things up and create a berrylicious 
look for the season! 🍒

Let's get cozy and glam with those deep, rich berry shades to make 
winter absolutely fabulous! 💄❄️

Also, seeing is believing! 🍑 You can see how KATE's new Tone Bakuage 
Cushion made my skin look in this video~ I'm using the shade 01 Fair 
Pink ~😍

It gives my face this incredible white peachy, juicy glow that's 
seriously mind-blowing. I can almost imagine taking a bite! 🍑💫


Winter beauty with a juicy twist, here I come! 💄❄️✨

■Product page
https://www.nomorerules.net/pickup/color_and_cover_cushion/


■KATE ZONE
https://kate-zone.kao-kirei.com/personalmakeup/foundation?cid=KT_DT_YT_001_2310&openExternalBrowser=1#zone1-foundation
